record.oneLiner: REST API that returns YouTube video transcripts, metadata, search and channel data, with an MCP integration.
record.verdictReason: A free API key gives 100 credits with no card, and the API is read-only GET endpoints covering transcripts, search, channels and playlists. The vendor documents its own MCP integration with a Claude setup guide.
